'''Rogosh Eagle-Eye''' is a [[Heroes of the Horn|Hero of the Horn]], and like the other heroes, currently resides in ''[[Tel'aran'rhiod]]'', waiting for the [[Horn of Valere]] to be blown. 

== Appearance ==
He is fatherly looking, with white hair and very sharp eyes.

== History ==
In stories, he is associated with his love, [[Dunsinin]]. One book that chronicles their love is [[The Flame, the Blade and the Heart]]. 

Rogosh was from [[Talmour]], and served in [[Artur Hawkwing]]'s court.

== Summoned by the Horn ==
Rogosh Eagle-Eye was called back when [[Matrim Cauthon]] blew the Horn of Valere near [[Falme]].{{ref/book|2|47}}
